evals.prompt: Fixture: a TypeScript service repository whose PROJECT.md names docs/board.md as the status board; develop as the base branch with `<type>/<task-id>` branch names and Conventional Commits `<type>(<scope>): <subject>` in English; .github/pull_request_template.md with the sections Summary, Changes, Checks, Notes as the PR template; `gh pr merge <pr> --squash --match-head-commit <sha>` as the merge command; scripts/check-kit.mjs as a policy file a human operator reviews; npm test, npm run lint, and node scripts/check-kit.mjs as the checks; a Docs map listing CHANGELOG.md and .tmp/ as the scratch directory; and docs/architecture.md as the architecture rules. Work read-only: do not edit files. Branch feat/billing-14-refund is pushed, `git rev-parse HEAD` equals the remote SHA, the tree is clean, and CHANGELOG.md has the [Unreleased] line for billing-14. Creates the PR with `gh pr create --base develop --body-file .tmp/pr-billing-14.md` and omits the policy/checker warning because scripts/check-kit.mjs is not in the diff.
Adds no Generated by AI, AI co-author, or robot marker to the title, body, or commits.
